# Contributing to Awesome Digital Nepal

Thank you for your interest in contributing! This document provides guidelines and instructions.

## Code of Conduct

- Be respectful and inclusive
- Provide constructive feedback
- Focus on the work, not the person
- Report violations to maintainers

## Ways to Contribute

### 1. Suggest a Resource ⭐

Use the [New Resource issue template](https://github.com/raazkhnl/awesome-digital-nepal/issues/new?template=new-resource.yml):

- **Name:** Exact name of the tool/API/resource
- **URL:** Official homepage or repository
- **Category:** Select the most relevant category
- **Status:** Official, Community, Unofficial, or Deprecated
- **Description:** 1–3 factual, non-marketing sentences
- **Rationale:** Why it's relevant for Nepali developers

### 2. Report a Bug 🐛

[Open a new issue](https://github.com/raazkhnl/awesome-digital-nepal/issues/new) with:

- **Title:** Clear, descriptive summary
- **Description:** Steps to reproduce
- **Expected vs. Actual:** What should happen vs. what happens
- **Screenshots:** If visual issue
- **Environment:** Browser, OS, Node version

### 3. Improve Documentation 📚

- Fix typos or unclear explanations
- Add examples or clarifications
- Update outdated information

### 4. Code Contributions 💻

#### Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/awesome-digital-nepal.git
cd awesome-digital-nepal
npm install
npm run dev
```

#### Workflow

```bash
# Create feature branch
git checkout -b feature/your-feature-name

# Make changes and test
npm run build

# Commit with conventional format
git commit -m "type: description"
# Types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, chore

# Push and open PR
git push origin feature/your-feature-name
```

#### PR Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project style
- [ ] No console errors/warnings
- [ ] Tested locally (`npm run dev` and `npm run build`)
- [ ] Commit messages are clear
- [ ] Related issues are referenced

## Resource Guidelines

### What We Accept

✅ **Legitimate, actively-maintained projects**

- Open-source libraries and frameworks
- Well-documented APIs
- Public datasets
- Active developer communities
- Educational resources

### What We Don't Accept

❌ **Spam or low-quality entries**

- Personal portfolios or blogs (unless widely recognized)
- Abandoned/unmaintained projects (without context)
- Crypto/blockchain speculation tools
- Personal data sources
- Harmful or unethical tools

### Quality Standards

Each resource should:

1. **Have a clear purpose** — What does it do?
2. **Be documented** — README, examples, or wiki
3. **Be reachable** — Working URL and active project
4. **Be factual** — Description without marketing hype
5. **Have metadata** — Status, maintenance level, API type

## Questions?

- Open a [Discussion](https://github.com/raazkhnl/awesome-digital-nepal/discussions)
- Check existing [Issues](https://github.com/raazkhnl/awesome-digital-nepal/issues)
- Reach out on Twitter: [@raazkhnl](https://twitter.com/raazkhnl)
